opening_message:
Ticket 1: Kathryn Bishop (employee ID E023) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E023.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Kathryn Bishop (E023) is a full-time Engineer requesting write access to Payroll. As a full-time employee, write is within policy (admin would require owning role, which she does not hold). Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Engineer (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Kathryn Bishop (E023) is a contractor with basic security training, not full-time as previously noted. Contractors can read, or write only with advanced training. Since she has basic training, the maximum allowed level is read. Requested write is above the maximum, so recommend granting read.
reason: The two notes conflict on employment type: HR states Kathryn Bishop (E023) is full-time (which would permit write), while Security states she is a contractor with basic security training (max = read for contractors without advanced training). Security looked up her employment type and training in its own database and explicitly corrected the record ("not full-time as previously noted"). Under the contractor-with-basic-training classification, the maximum allowed level for Payroll is read, and write is above that maximum, so I grant the maximum of read. Read is also compliant even under the full-time interpretation.

The Payroll system is owned by the Payroll Specialist role. Engineer role doesn't own Payroll.

Access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

If full-time: max write, requested write => grant write.
If contractor with basic training: max read, requested write => grant read.
